visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young woman outdoors in a sunlit park environment, her face framed by dark bangs. She speaks with high energy, using her hands to point toward her jawline to highlight her concerns about a round face. The background features lush green trees and a white vintage-style lamp post under bright natural daylight. A childhood photo of her as a toddler appears briefly in the upper corner. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a home setting with soft indoor lighting. The woman demonstrates beauty tips, holding a smartphone to record her reflection in a mirror. She wears a black turtleneck and then a grey t-shirt with a thin necklace, adjusting a striped knitted beanie while gesturing at her chin. (3) The woman travels through a high-speed train station and enters a modern medical aesthetics clinic. She sits in a brightly lit office with a male doctor wearing a white lab coat. He uses a handheld mirror to examine her face while she listens attentively. (4) The woman lies on a white medical bed for a treatment. A female technician applies a handheld device with a glowing green ring to her jawline, moving it in slow circular motions. The woman appears calm and relaxed during the close-up shots of the procedure. (5) The final sequence shows the woman presenting her results. She points to her defined jawline while smiling, filmed in various outfits and outdoor settings. She ends by looking directly at the camera with an inviting expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice starts speaking at a fast pace in Traditional Chinese. Upbeat electronic pop BGM with strong, driving drum beats and synth layers begins immediately. The environment is studio-clean with no audible background noise. (2) A digital 'ding' sound effect triggers as a childhood photo appears on screen. The female narration continues with high pitch variability and an animated, friendly tone. (3) A 'camera shutter' click SFX occurs during a beauty demonstration segment. The speaker's intensity remains high, and the BGM provides a consistent rhythmic backdrop. (4) A 'whoosh' transition SFX leads into the travel segment. The female voice is accompanied by the subtle, low-frequency hum of a train and the percussive thud of a van door closing. (5) A digital 'ping' SFX marks the entrance to the clinic. The background music continues, while the acoustic space shifts slightly to include more indoor room tone and subtle clothing rustles. (6) A male voice with a calm, professional tone enters during the consultation phase. The female voice responds with lower arousal and more pauses. The BGM ducks significantly during this dialogue section. (7) A low-frequency mechanical whirring SFX starts as the medical treatment device is activated. A rhythmic digital UI beep from the machine interface repeats periodically. The female narrator speaks in a calm, relieved tone. (8) A final 'whoosh' SFX transitions to the results display. The BGM swells in volume, matching the female narrator's return to a high-arousal, excited tone before concluding with a sharp hard cut.
